title: AI tools for predicting protein folding produce chemically impossible structures and need human oversight
description: Researchers at Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute (RPI) have found that today's leading artificial intelligence tools for predicting protein structures routinely generate results that are physically and chemically impossible, exposing critical blind spots in how AI is being applied across scientific research. The work, published in the Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences, serves as a cautionary reminder that AI still requires human oversight and physics-based verification to produce reliable results in the lab.

title: Why technology alone cannot stop exam paper leaks: The ‘trust’ problem explained
description: India's examination system is becoming increasingly dependent on encryption, artificial intelligence, surveillance and digital testing. Yet the biggest vulnerability may remain the people who set questions, validate papers, translate content and supervise candidates. The challenge for policymakers is not simply to add more technology, but to redesign the examination process so that no single insider can compromise an entire test, while ensuring transparency and accountability at every stage.

title: Karnataka: RuralShores & Sathya Sai varsity launch AI skilling centre to connect village youth with global tech jobs
description: Karnataka Chief Secretary inaugurated a new rural artificial intelligence skill center. This initiative aims to equip young people with essential technology skills. The center will provide training in generative AI and industry exposure. It seeks to create technology-led employment opportunities within villages. This program will help rural youth compete globally without migrating to cities.
